label: neiso 57 dynrr ablation
definition: (ABLATION TWIN of 2026-07-10-neiso-57-dynamic-rr) rule-20 zero-forcing ablation — the same neiso-56-keeper-plus-dynamic-requirements recipe with all merchant floors/bridges off (nuclear must-run, CHP steam-following, coal take-or-pay kept).
